{{Quote|But... it's so ''plain''."<br />"Apparently not, ''if'' you can see in the ultraviolet range. Zraii says it's a masterpiece."<br />That explains why I'm a warrior, not an artist.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] observing Ooryl's X-wing.|<ref name="BW" />}}
'''Ooryl Qrygg's T-65 X-wing''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] purchased for the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] after he resigned his commission to the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]] to help the former members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In order to ensure that [[Antilles's Rogues]] appeared distinct from the New Republic, Ooryl Qrygg and his squadmates were given the chance to customise their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wings]]. Ooryl chose to paint the hull of his fighter in a beautiful and complex pattern that could only be seen by those who can view the ultraviolet spectrum. To the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]], [[Zraii]], it was a masterpiece, but to the rest of the Rogues it looked stark white.<ref name="BW" />
